description: The optional on-signet transaction for a shrincs-l-stateful contest entry, which earns it the leaderboard's on-signet badge. Lock coins to the entry's verifier.simf under a SHRINCS-L key, then spend them with a SHRINCS signature. The spend pays dust to the contest watch address and carries the contest tag. Copy this file into your entry's folder. Change only the Spend input's `witnesses`, so they name the witnesses your verifier reads, each taken from a param of the same name. Then run `tx-manifest-wallet pin`. Every other per-entry value goes in the params files. The outputs and the tag are what the indexer checks, so leave them alone.

entry.description: Coins spendable only by a SHRINCS-L signature by PK over the spending transaction, as checked by this entry's verifier.

PK.description: SHRINCS public key, PK.seed || PK.root, as `shrincs-signer pubkey` prints it.

Lock.description: Send coins to the entry's verifier, under a SHRINCS key.
Lock.intent: Lock {params.amount_sat} sat to a contest entry

PK.description: SHRINCS public key to lock to.

Spend.description: The on-signet spend: a SHRINCS signature, dust to the watch address, and the contest tag.
Spend.$comment: Two runs with the same state file and params: first --print-sighash with placeholder SIG / OTHER_ROOT, then with the witness values the entry's convert.lua produces from `shrincs-signer sign`. The witnesses here (SIG, OTHER_ROOT) are the baseline's; an entry lists its own. The tag is "PQC" || version 0x00 || category 0x01 || ENTRY_ID (8 bytes) || PK (32 bytes).

PK.description: The SHRINCS public key the coin is locked to.

ENTRY_ID.description: The first 8 bytes of SHA-256 of verifier.simf, as 16 hex digits.

watch_address.description: The contest watch address, as published in the rules.

dest.description: Where the rest goes. Fixed, so both runs build the same transaction.

SIG.description: The signature witness, as convert.lua produces it. Any placeholder for the --print-sighash run.

OTHER_ROOT.description: The other witness, as convert.lua produces it. Any placeholder for the --print-sighash run.

ui.label: dust to the contest watch address
the rest, less the network fee
